build_Action_agent: build a continuous control policy network that outputs actions with learnable mean and log standard deviation
build_MultiAction_agent: build a multi-task policy agent that clones the last model for a new task via set_task
build_FromScratchAction_agent: build a multi-task policy agent that creates a fresh model for each new task via set_task
build_EWCAction_agent: build an EWC regularized policy agent that consolidates Fisher information to prevent catastrophic forgetting
build_Critic_network: build a Q-value critic network that takes observations and actions as input and outputs a scalar value
